downstreamNote: DOWNSTREAM MEASUREMENT, NOT A RATIFICATION. This is the union tree: it carries BOTH fork features, so its agent-facing surface is larger than upstream's. skill-memory registers two additional tools (ctx_skill_note, ctx_skill_recall) plus their guidance prose; external-memory adds no tools but widens two existing ones (ctx_memory gains scope:"global", ctx_search gains the "external" source). Re-measured from source on this tree after the upstream v0.42.3 rebase: mutableProseBaseline 4283, integerLightCeiling floor(0.50 * 4283) = 2141. Upstream reference for comparison: 3750 / 1825 over five active tools. The policy expression, tokenizer identity, primary variant, and inclusion/exclusion lists are UNCHANGED — only the measurement moved, and the ceiling is a derived consequence of a larger surface rather than a request to relax the budget. These values are regenerated from source on each rebase, never hand-edited. If these tools ever land upstream, ratifying the increase is upstream's call.
